entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The central city of Amonkhet and home of its gods, on the banks of the Luxa; ravaged after the Hour of Devastation and since partly rebuilt.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The desert plane whose central city is Naktamun.

entities.name: Hekma
entities.description: A magical barrier protecting Naktamun from the desert and cursed undead, maintained by the god Kefnet and raised again by Hazoret.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: The god who maintained the Hekma.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon planeswalker whose Eternal army destroyed Naktamun.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god who led the survivors in reclaiming Naktamun, ignited Phyrexian oil with her flaming spear, and directed the rebuilding.

entities.name: Scarab God
entities.description: An inscrutable insect god whose undead hordes fought the Phyrexians in Naktamun.

entities.name: Locust God
entities.description: An inscrutable insect god who fought the Phyrexians alongside the Scarab God.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: Led a crop of elite fighters to dismember the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A former planeswalker who serves as vizier of Naktamun after the invasion.

entities.name: Amonkheti survivors
entities.description: The surviving people of Amonkhet who rebuilt Naktamun under Hazoret.

entities.name: Broken Lands
entities.description: The wasteland where the insect gods retreated and where lost undead wander.

entities.name: Luxa River
entities.description: The river by Naktamun, fouled for years and turned to blood by Razaketh, then flowing clear again.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A demon who turned the Luxa to blood after the Hour of Revelation.

entities.name: Hour of Devastation
entities.description: Nicol Bolas's attack on Amonkhet that destroyed Naktamun and slew most of its gods.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which Amonkhet was a target.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker whose mind reading revealed Naktamun's districts to the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group that entered Naktamun through the Hekma.

events.summary: After the Hour of Devastation, Bolas's Eternal army destroys Naktamun and slays most of its gods; the survivors under Hazoret flee.
events.quote: the city was destroyed by the Eternal army of Nicol Bolas, and most of its gods were slain

events.summary: When the Eternals leave for Ravnica, Hazoret and the survivors reclaim Naktamun, raise the Hekma and begin rebuilding.
events.quote: Hazoret and the other survivors reclaimed the city

events.summary: The survivors arrive at Naktamun and find the Scarab God and Locust God already fighting the Phyrexian invaders.
events.quote: they found the Scarab God and Locust God already there, engaged with the invaders

events.summary: Hazoret ignites the glistening oil in the Phyrexians' veins and Djeru's crop dismembers them.
events.quote: Hazoret used her flaming spear to ignite the glistening oil within the Phyrexians' veins

events.summary: The insect gods depart for the deep desert without a word.
events.quote: the inscrutable insect gods departed for the deep desert without a word

events.summary: The Amonkheti declare victory and the Luxa begins to run clear while rebuilding begins.
events.quote: the Luxa fouled for so long, and began to flow clear

events.summary: Naktamun's loyal undead plead to be freed in exchange for defending the city, and the living agree.
events.quote: Free us, and we will see Naktamun preserved.

events.summary: Samut, a former planeswalker, becomes vizier of Naktamun.
events.quote: the former planeswalker Samut now serves as vizier of Naktamun

relations.quote: once the central city of Amonkhet

relations.note: Led the survivors out of the city and back.

relations.note: Naktamun was the last city standing against him.
relations.quote: Naktamun was the last city that stood against him
